Account Director Enterprise (DC) Eunetworks Berlin Sales 32 minutes Sales Berlin 32m Preferred locations are London, Berlin, Frankfurt, Munich and Hanover; with domestic and occasional international travel as required. The Role Driven by the rapid digital transformation of businesses across Europe, demand for high-capacity, reliable connectivity from Enterprise customers continues to grow. Thanks to our continued investment in the development of European fibre networks, euNetworks is a leader in Data Centre to Data Centre connectivity, supporting Hyperscale, Enterprise, Content and Wholesale customers across the region. Reporting to the Sales Director Data Centres you will play a key role in driving new business growth across the Enterprise market. You will do this by partnering, 'selling with' with the sales teams of our DC customers to develop connectivity solutions for their DC tenants. Working in an experienced team, you will have the opportunity to develop and close large-scale European network opportunities (100G/400G) with Enterprise organisations that require high-performance connectivity across multiple locations. While you will also support the development of a small number of existing accounts, the primary focus of this role is building pipeline, acquiring new logos and expanding euNetworks’ presence within the Enterprise sector. You will have the support of our Sales Engineering team, with multiple engineers and additional account support available. You will also work closely with our Network Development, Digital Enablement and Product teams to shape solutions that meet customer needs and drive successful outcomes. What will you be doing? Identify, target and win new Enterprise customers, building a strong pipeline of opportunities across the Europe. Develop and execute new business sales strategies to expand euNetworks’ presence in the Enterprise market. Build relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within prospective customer organisations. Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract signature, meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets. Maintain a strong understanding of the Enterprise connectivity market, identifying trends, potential customers and new opportunities. Network at industry events, customer meetings and campaigns to generate leads and strengthen euNetworks’ market presence. Work closely with Sales Engineering and Product teams to develop technically and commercially viable solutions for customers. Collaborate with commercial and finance teams to develop strong business cases and proposals. Support the development and growth of selected existing accounts, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. Effectively manage sales activity and pipeline through Salesforce.com, ensuring accurate reporting and data integrity What do we want from you? Significant sales experience within Telecoms, Connectivity, Infrastructure or Technology markets Strong new business development experience, with a proven ability to generate pipeline and win new customers A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets Experience selling connectivity, network infrastructure or data centre solutions to Enterprise customers An entrepreneurial mindset, with the drive to identify opportunities and develop new relationships Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills Experience managing complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail A self-starter who is comfortable prospecting and building opportunities from scratch Good understanding of the European Telecoms and Enterprise connectivity market If this position is of interest but you don’t think you meet all of the criteria listed, please consider applying still. euNetworks looks to recruit people with the right attitude, potential and ambition and for the right candidate, we will provide further training and support to enable you to develop in the role. What can we offer you? At euNetworks we invest in our people by offering a range of benefits and development opportunities designed to support your professional growth and personal wellbeing. Employees have access to a comprehensive wellbeing programme that promotes mental health and also recognises the importance of work-life balance through initiatives such as a dedicated birthday day off and “give back” days to support volunteering activities. euNetworks’ bonus scheme is linked to both individual contribution and overall company performance with opportunity to overachieve in both areas. In addition, euNetworks operates a flexible hybrid working policy, enabling employees to balance in-office collaboration with remote work, fostering productivity, autonomy and a positive employee experience. Our Family Friendly Policy delivers enhanced and inclusive parental benefits that can viewed here Insurances, pensions, leave and additional enhancements are modelled to work with local country provisions, please email [email protected] for more details. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Our company values drive our behaviour and form the basis of how we operate our business. We work as a team promoting a culture of collaboration, trust and respect where every individual is heard. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and commit to providing each individual with the support, continued learning and the tools to achieve their goals and an environment in which they can thrive. We strive to make the hiring process equitable and accessible for all. Providing candidates with the opportunity to be their true selves and explore how you might thrive at euNetworks. We are a recognised Disability Confident employer and will make provisions where possible to support you through the interview process, if you require any reasonable accommodation through the selection process, please let your Talent Partner know. What do we do? euNetworks is a pan-European provider of bandwidth infrastructure services and a vital enabler of Cloud and AI adoption. We’re the leading connectivity partner for data centre companies and their customers in Europe, directly connecting over 600 data centres today. We own and operate 18 metropolitan city networks connected with a high capacity intercity backbone covering 53 cities in 17 countries. A leading provider of cloud connectivity, we directly connect to all major cloud platforms. Sales Director, Payments (DACH) Fireblocks Berlin Sales 25 minutes Sales Berlin 25m Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale Here’s the bit about the opportunity: Joining the EMEA Fireblocks sales team, you will drive growth for Fireblocks within blockchain payments sector in the DACH region. As a key member of a leading blockchain and cybersecurity firm, you will target PSP, Cross-Border, Remittances and various other payment providers whilst collaborating closely with regional sales teams, Sales Engineers, and the Payments product team. You’ll be: Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Collaborating with the Fireblocks BDR and GTM teams to generate and qualify leads. Building and nurturing strong relationships with prospects and customers. Conducting prospecting, territory, and account planning to identify new opportunities. Keeping the Fireblocks CRM up-to-date with accurate account and pipeline information. You’ll bring: Enterprise SaaS or institutional sales experience, selling into the Payments space Passion for blockchain technology and cryptocurrency Experience within financial services, cybersecurity, or cryptocurrency is preferred Experience in formalising and supporting the co-sell motion in working with technology partners is preferred Track record of over-achievement in an enterprise sales position Entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude A willingness to prospect and qualify for new opportunities Thrives in a team-selling environment We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for A players who want to work with the best. Track record of success and closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sectors For employees hired to work from the EU, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range is specific to Germany and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is €80,400 – €100,500. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here . Senior Hauptbuchhalter (m/w/d) FINN Munich Finance & Legal Full Time 1 hour Finance & Legal Full Time Munich 1h Your Role Als Senior Hauptbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist du das Rückgrat unseres Finanzwesens und treibst die Skalierbarkeit unserer Hauptbuchhaltung maßgeblich voran. In unserer modernen SAP S/4HANA-Umgebung übernimmst du die Verantwortung für komplexe Abschlussprozesse, sicherst eine makellose Datenqualität unserer Subsysteme und gestaltest Intercompany-Workflows. Mit deiner Accounting-Expertise transformierst du klassische Buchhaltung in hochautomatisierte, zukunftssichere Finanzprozesse und legst das Fundament für FINNs weltweites Wachstum. Your Mission Master the General Ledger: Du führst und stimmst die Hauptbücher eigenverantwortlich für ausgewählte Gesellschaften ab und garantierst eine lückenlose, rechtssichere Buchführung nach HGB. Drive financial closings: Du treibst die Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen proaktiv voran und agierst als kompetente Schnittstelle bei Audits sowie steuerlichen Prüfungen. Optimize data & automation: Du sicherst die Datenqualität zwischen operativen Subsystemen und dem Hauptbuch und hebst durch gezielte Kontrollen neue Automatisierungspotenziale. Manage complex structures: Du betreust komplexe Finanzinstrumente und treibst Sonderprojekte, wie beispielsweise die Bilanzierung von ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkäufen, erfolgreich voran. Streamline intercompany workflows: Du verantwortest die reibungslose Abstimmung und Verrechnung zwischen unseren Gesellschaften und etablierst effiziente, konzernweite Finanzprozesse. Ensure compliance & guidelines: Du stellst die strikte Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften sowie unserer internen Richtlinien sicher und agierst als verlässlicher Sparringspartner im Team. Your Profile Must have: Fundierte Accounting-Expertise: Langjährige, praxiserprobte Berufserfahrung in der Hauptbuchhaltung (General Ledger), idealerweise erworben in einem dynamischen Finanzdienstleistungs-, Fintech- oder Scale-up-Umfeld. Starke HGB- & Sonderstruktur-Kenntnisse: Fundiertes Fachwissen in der Bilanzierung nach HGB sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Betreuung komplexer Finanzinstrumente (z. B. ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkauf) gepaart mit einem passenden Studium oder einer Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK). System- & ERP-Affinität: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Anwendung und Optimierung moderner ERP-Systeme (vorzugsweise SAP S/4HANA) sowie eine stark analytische, strukturierte und zahlenaffine Arbeitsweise. Lösungsorientierte Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte präzise zu vermitteln – auf Deutsch (min. B2) sowie mit guten, sicheren Englischkenntnissen. Nice to have: IFRS-Kenntnisse: Erste praktische Berührungspunkte oder fundierte Kenntnisse in der internationalen Bilanzierung nach IFRS. Prozessautomatisierung: Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Product- oder Tech-Teams zur Automatisierung von Schnittstellen und Finanz-Subsystemen. WHY FINN Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN. Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst. Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 % . Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing) . Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support. Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München . On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch - Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen . Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam. About Us FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an! Weitere Informationen: www.finn.com Gleiche Chancen für Alle FINN steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen. Bereit für die Mobilität der Zukunft? Bewirb dich jetzt! Komm an Board und werde Teil unserer Hyper-Growth-Story! Dein First Point of Contact ist Annika - wir halten die Wege kurz und begleiten dich Schritt für Schritt. Alles, was du über unseren Bewerbungsprozess und unsere Unternehmenskultur wissen musst, erfährst du direkt in Careers @FINN . source_record.description:
Your Role
Als Senior Hauptbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist du das Rückgrat unseres Finanzwesens und treibst die Skalierbarkeit unserer Hauptbuchhaltung maßgeblich voran. In unserer modernen SAP S/4HANA-Umgebung übernimmst du die Verantwortung für komplexe Abschlussprozesse, sicherst eine makellose Datenqualität unserer Subsysteme und gestaltest Intercompany-Workflows. Mit deiner Accounting-Expertise transformierst du klassische Buchhaltung in hochautomatisierte, zukunftssichere Finanzprozesse und legst das Fundament für FINNs weltweites Wachstum.

Your Mission
  • Master the General Ledger: Du führst und stimmst die Hauptbücher eigenverantwortlich für ausgewählte Gesellschaften ab und garantierst eine lückenlose, rechtssichere Buchführung nach HGB.
  • Drive financial closings: Du treibst die Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen proaktiv voran und agierst als kompetente Schnittstelle bei Audits sowie steuerlichen Prüfungen.
  • Optimize data & automation: Du sicherst die Datenqualität zwischen operativen Subsystemen und dem Hauptbuch und hebst durch gezielte Kontrollen neue Automatisierungspotenziale.
  • Manage complex structures: Du betreust komplexe Finanzinstrumente und treibst Sonderprojekte, wie beispielsweise die Bilanzierung von ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkäufen, erfolgreich voran.
  • Streamline intercompany workflows: Du verantwortest die reibungslose Abstimmung und Verrechnung zwischen unseren Gesellschaften und etablierst effiziente, konzernweite Finanzprozesse.
  • Ensure compliance & guidelines: Du stellst die strikte Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften sowie unserer internen Richtlinien sicher und agierst als verlässlicher Sparringspartner im Team.

    • Your Profile
    Must have: 
  • Fundierte Accounting-Expertise: Langjährige, praxiserprobte Berufserfahrung in der Hauptbuchhaltung (General Ledger), idealerweise erworben in einem dynamischen Finanzdienstleistungs-, Fintech- oder Scale-up-Umfeld.
  • Starke HGB- & Sonderstruktur-Kenntnisse: Fundiertes Fachwissen in der Bilanzierung nach HGB sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Betreuung komplexer Finanzinstrumente (z. B. ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkauf) gepaart mit einem passenden Studium oder einer Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK).
  • System- & ERP-Affinität: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Anwendung und Optimierung moderner ERP-Systeme (vorzugsweise SAP S/4HANA) sowie eine stark analytische, strukturierte und zahlenaffine Arbeitsweise.
  • Lösungsorientierte Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte präzise zu vermitteln – auf Deutsch (min. B2) sowie mit guten, sicheren Englischkenntnissen.
    • Nice to have:
  • IFRS-Kenntnisse: Erste praktische Berührungspunkte oder fundierte Kenntnisse in der internationalen Bilanzierung nach IFRS. 
  • Prozessautomatisierung: Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Product- oder Tech-Teams zur Automatisierung von Schnittstellen und Finanz-Subsystemen.

    • WHY FINN

  • Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.

  • Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.

  • Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung, exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 %.

  • Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing).

  • Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support.

  • Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München. On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch-Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen.

  • Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.


    • About Us
    FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!
     
    Weitere Informationen: www.finn.com

     

    Gleiche Chancen für Alle

    FINN steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

    Bereit für die Mobilität der Zukunft? Bewirb dich jetzt!

    Komm an Board und werde Teil unserer Hyper-Growth-Story! 


    Dein First Point of Contact ist Annika - wir halten die Wege kurz und begleiten dich Schritt für Schritt. Alles, was du über unseren Bewerbungsprozess und unsere Unternehmenskultur wissen musst, erfährst du direkt in Careers -----

  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture

  • Develop scalable synthetic data generation pipelines using Unreal Engine 5
  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality Unreal Engine systems using C++, Python, Blueprints, and custom plugins
  • Develop tools and automation to improve simulation workflows and dataset generation
  • Create, integrate, and optimize realistic environments, assets, and rendering pipelines
  • Work extensively with Blender and 3D assets to build high-quality simulation environments

  • Practical experience using Blender for creating, editing, or optimizing 3D assets
  • Solid experience with Unreal Engine 5, including: C++ development, Plugin development, Blueprints, Asset integration
  • Experience building production-quality software rather than academic or hobby projects
  • Good understanding of rendering pipelines, simulation environments, or synthetic data generation
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows


Nice to have

  • Experience with synthetic data generation for AI or computer vision applications
  • Familiarity with robotics, autonomous systems, or simulation environments
  • Experience with procedural generation, digital twins, or geospatial datasets
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or StackIT 


What else

  • Intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset
  • Creative thinker with a structured and systematic approach
  • Humble and collaborative — prioritizes collective success over individual recognition
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic
  • Extra-curricular leadership or achievements are a bonus
  • Fluent in English, German is a plus

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

source_record.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

This role owns the data foundation of our perception systems end-to-end — the layer that directly determines model performance in real-world environments. You'll set the technical direction for how we collect, curate, and continuously improve the datasets behind object detection, working as a senior technical partner to ML, perception, and robotics teams — turning raw, messy sensor data into reliable, production-grade systems at scale.

You will take full ownership of the ML data lifecycle — from architecture decisions on ingestion and pipelines, through labeling strategy and QA, to driving continuous, metrics-informed dataset improvement — and will be expected to bring judgment and prior experience to how this is done, not just execute a defined process.



What you'll do:

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)
  • Drive the strategy behind our object detection datasets, ensuring quality, diversity, and statistical representativeness at scale
  • Design and operate active learning loops that connect model performance directly to data selection and improvement priorities
  • Own labeling workflows end-to-end — tooling decisions, QA methodology, consistency standards, and coordination of annotation efforts
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to diagnose model weaknesses, bias, and drift, and translate findings into concrete dataset strategy
  • Plan and lead data collection campaigns (field recordings, drone/video capture) to close gaps with high-value real-world data
  • Build internal tools and dashboards that give the org visibility into dataset quality, distribution, and performance gaps


Your profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and data processing frameworks (Pandas, NumPy, vectorized operations, multiprocessing)
  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows
  • Deep familiarity with data annotation platforms (CVAT, Label Studio) and building automated QA/consistency checks
  • Strong grasp of evaluation metrics for object detection (IoU, mAP, precision-recall curves, class-wise metrics)
  • Comfortable owning decisions around databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and large-scale image, video, and sensor dataset management
  • Track record of working cross-functionally and influencing perception, deployment, robotics, and data infrastructure teams
  • Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.


What else

  • Outside-the-box creativity with a blend of conceptual and systematic design thinking.
  • High intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Structured, methodical, and reliable execution, even under uncertainty.
  • Humble, collaborative, and mission-driven — values collective success over ego.
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic.
  • Extra-curricular achievements, leadership, or unique projects are a plus.
  • NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required.


Why us?

Join us to shape the future of AI-driven defense!

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Vor der Kamera bist du in deinem Element, selbstsicher, authentisch, nahbar für deine Community. Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch – deine Community folgt dir gerne, und auch die Abstimmung mit dem Content & Communications Team läuft reibungslos. Ideen sprudeln bei dir von selbst – statt Bestehendes zu kopieren, probierst du gerne Neues aus und gehst dabei auch mal eigene Wege. Trotz kreativem Kopfchaos planst, priorisierst und lieferst du zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich ab – Selbstorganisation und Umsetzungsstärke sind für dich selbstverständlich. source_record.description:
Your mission

Als Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter wirst Du Teil unseres zentralen Accounting-Teams. Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung der AP/AR-Accountants und arbeitest eng mit Controlling, Treasury, Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern zusammen. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du den weiteren Aufbau einer modernen, internationalen Finanzorganisation.

  • Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS
  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung mehrerer Gesellschaften
  • Fachliche Führung und Unterstützung der AP/AR-Accountants
  • Mitarbeit an der Konzernberichterstattung und Intercompany-Abstimmungen
  • Erstellung von Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen sowie weiteren steuerlichen Meldungen
  • Koordination und fachliche Begleitung bei Jahresabschluss- und Betriebsprüfungen
  • Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres ERP-Systems Oracle NetSuite
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Accounting-Prozessen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Controlling, Treasury und Operations


Your profile

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen, einschließlich fundierter, mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen
  • Gute HGB- und IFRS-Kenntnisse
  • Erfahrung im Konzernumfeld
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2 Niveau)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel; ERP-Erfahrung (z. B. NetSuite, SAP oder Microsoft Dynamics) von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise


Why us?

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Mitarbeit in einer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe der Erneuerbaren Energien
  • Moderne ERP-Landschaft (Oracle NetSuite)
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und in Abstimmung tageweise mobiles Arbeiten
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub
  • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung nach der Probezeit
  • Die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten

source_record.description:
Deine Mission

Als Retail Promoter: arbeitest du freitags und samstags im Store und bist dort das Gesicht der Marke. Du begeisterst Kunden für innovative Consumer-Tech-Produkte, führst Produktdemonstrationen durch und unterstützt aktiv den Abverkauf im Handel.

Durch deine Beratung und Produktkenntnis sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden die Produkte erleben, verstehen und sich für einen Kauf entscheiden.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen insbesondere:

  • Aktive Ansprache von Kunden im Store und Begeisterung für die Produkte

  • Durchführung von Produktdemonstrationen und Beratungsgesprächen

  • Unterstützung beim Abverkauf und Förderung der Markenpräsenz im Store

  • Sicherstellung einer optimalen Präsentation der Produkte am Point of Sale

  • Erfassung deiner Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse über ein digitales Reporting-System

  • Weitergabe von Kundenfeedback und Marktinformationen an das Projektteam


Dein Profil

Du hast Freude daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten, erklärst gerne Produkte und trittst offen und überzeugend auf. Die Rolle eignet sich besonders gut für Werkstudierende — du studierst nicht? Auch okay, die Stelle steht allen offen, die Lust auf den Job haben.

Experience & Education

  • Erste Erfahrung im Verkauf, Promotion, Retail oder Kundenservice von Vorteil

  • Interesse an Consumer-Tech-Produkten und neuen Technologien

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt ist ein Plus

  • Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Skills & Attributes

  • Offene, kommunikative und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit

  • Freude am Verkauf und an der Beratung von Kunden

  • Selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Sicheres Auftreten und Begeisterungsfähigkeit im Kundengespräch

  • Grundlegender Umgang mit Smartphone / Apps für Reporting

  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on Mentalität

  • Fähigkeit, technische Produkte einfach und verständlich zu erklären und Kunden dafür zu begeistern


Warum Wir?

Bei uns arbeitest du für führende internationale Tech-Brands und bist direkt im Store aktiv.

  • Erlebe Innovation: Arbeite mit spannenden Consumer-Tech-Produkten

  • Direkter Kundenkontakt: Begeistere Menschen für neue Technologien

  • Team & Support: Werde Teil eines motivierten Promoter-Teams

  • Flexibilität: Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Retail mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben


Diese Recruiting Steps erwarten dich

  1. Culture Fit – Lerne unsere Talent Acquisition Managerin kennen. Hier erfährst du mehr über unser Unternehmen und unsere Kultur.

  2. Fachinterview – Hier tauchst du gemeinsam mit Caro (Projektleiterin) aus dem Fachbereich tiefer in die Rolle und die konkreten Aufgaben ein.

  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills

  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) in the Tech Advisory area, you will take on a key role in complex transformation projects. You will support our clients in the digital and organizational evolution of their business models and processes - from strategy development through to operational implementation.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, applying agile methodologies in a targeted and effective way. In transformation projects, you will play a central role by bringing structure, clarity, and strong execution capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include a wide range of tasks:

  • Supporting transformation initiatives: Assisting clients in the structured development and optimization of organizations, processes, and ways of working
  • Interface management between business and IT: Gathering, structuring, and aligning business requirements while ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives
  • (Partial) project management: Independently planning, coordinating, and delivering projects with a strong focus on sustainable results
  • Applying agile methodologies: Using agile ways of working and taking on relevant roles (e.g. Scrum Master or Product Owner) within projects
  • Change management: Designing and supporting transformation processes, including stakeholder management and implementation support
  • Process analysis and optimization: Identifying improvement opportunities and developing as well as implementing efficient, digitally enabled processes
  • Management-level communication and reporting: Conducting structured analyses and preparing content tailored to decision-makers and steering committees


YOUR PROFIL

We are looking for people with drive, a strong sense of responsibility, and a clear affinity for technology and transformation.
What you should bring to the role:

  • A completed degree in (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience (at least 3–5 years) in management consulting or in transformation/digitalization projects
  • Certification in agile project management, ideally as a Scrum Master or Product Owner, as well as hands-on experience applying agile methodologies

  • Project management expertise: Experience managing (sub-)projects, including planning, steering, and stakeholder communication
  • Experience in transformation and change management: Ability to support organizational change in a structured way and ensure sustainable implementation
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style
  • Excellent MS Office skills (especially PowerPoint and Excel), along with strong presentation and communication abilities
  • High level of initiative, strong teamwork skills, and a customer-oriented mindset

source_record.description:
YOUR TASKS

  • You support the development of databases and data integration processes
  • You contribute to the design and implementation of data models and data pipelines for modern data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouses
  • You assist in documenting and structuring data platforms and related processes
  • You participate in the development of interactive dashboards and reports, for example in the area of performance metrics and ESG
  • You support the application of data analytics methods and tools within project contexts
  • You assist users in the utilization and maintenance of data platforms and analytics solutions


YOUR PROFIL

  • You are currently enrolled as a student in an IT-related field, such as (Business) Informatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, or a related discipline
  • You have solid knowledge of the programming languages Python and SQL
  • You have experience in data visualization and presentation using Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Initial experience with Databricks is considered an advantage
  • You have a basic understanding of data modeling methods and data integration processes (ETL / ELT)
  • You work independently and in a structured manner and demonstrate strong teamwork and communication skills
  • You possess excellent German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)
  • You are able to work on-site at least 50% of the time in our office in Cologne or Munich


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us – we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You actively help shape our organization.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and transparent requirements for each level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best and most modern hardware (Apple or Windows) to support your work.
  • Flexible Working & Vacation Policy: Work remotely and adjust your working hours flexibly to fit around your studies.

YOUR TASKS

  • You assume overall responsibility for projects, key topics, and the company’s development within the field of cybersecurity
  • You take on leadership and strategic responsibilities in the consulting, design, and implementation of cybersecurity solutions
  • You ensure that defined milestones and project objectives are achieved
  • You manage stakeholder communication and lead status meetings
  • You serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, project leads, and team members, representing the team’s results externally
  • You assess and advise our clients in the field of cybersecurity and contribute to the development of new services and topic areas
  • You analyze complex processes and systems, particularly in the area of Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • You design solution concepts and IT architectures
  • You actively contribute to new client acquisition efforts
  • You conduct IT vulnerability assessments and risk evaluations of information security incidents and further develop internal security methodologies and standards
  • You lead and support transformation initiatives in the field of cybersecurity
  • You take responsibility for internal development initiatives aimed at expanding and strengthening our company


YOUR PROFIL

  • You hold a strong to very strong completed Master’s degree in Business Administration, (Business) Informatics, or a related discipline
  • You bring 5–8 years of professional experience in the field of cybersecurity, including the implementation of Zero Trust concepts and technologies
  • Ideally, you have gained experience in Identity & Access Management, Azure AD, Zero Trust, and/or security architecture design
  • You possess strong leadership capabilities and management experience
  • You have a very strong understanding of business processes in the field of cybersecurity
  • You have in-depth knowledge of networking as well as a comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity-specific architectures and principles
  • You demonstrate very strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts
  • You are enthusiastic about digital topics, strategies, and processes
  • You are a team player, highly motivated, adaptable, and proactive
  • You enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration and taking responsibility
  • You are willing to travel
  • You possess solid project management expertise
  • You have excellent German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.

YOUR TASKS

CRA, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, the EU AI Act – our clients face a wide range of regulatory requirements. For most companies, however, the path from regulatory requirements on paper to effective implementation in practice is far from clear.
For our Munich-based Cyber Team, we are looking for you if you want to support our clients on this journey:

  • You support our clients in implementing regulatory and cybersecurity-related requirements – from NIS2 and DORA to eIDAS and the EU AI Act – and translate them into processes that are actually embedded in day-to-day operations
  • You develop analyses, concepts, and target operating models in the context of complex and emerging cybersecurity topics (e.g. digital identity management, AI security, or AI observability) and drive their implementation through to completion
  • Depending on your professional experience, you lead projects as a project manager or take responsibility for individual work packages and workstreams
  • You assess existing structures, identify risks and gaps, and derive concrete measures and implementation plans from your findings
  • You collaborate with different teams on the client side (IT, Business, Compliance) to develop sustainable and effective solutions
  • You present complex topics in a way that is convincing both in expert-level discussions and at board-level meetings
  • You take on responsibility for your own work packages early on and, as your experience grows, progress into sub-project and project leadership roles
  • Beyond client projects, you contribute to internal initiatives, proposals, and the development of our Cybersecurity Practice by staying up to date with current developments in cybersecurity and regulation and bringing new ideas into client projects and internal initiatives


YOUR PROFIL

  • You have a strong understanding of IT and are interested in developing your knowledge in new and complex topics; in-depth technical expertise is not a prerequisite
  • You have completed a degree with good to very good results in business administration, (business) informatics, engineering, mathematics, natural sciences, or a comparable field
  • You have at least two years of professional experience in a relevant environment, ideally in consulting or a strategic role
  • You work in a structured manner, think analytically, and enjoy making complex topics easy to understand and suitable for management audiences
  • You communicate confidently and effectively with different target audiences and enjoy presenting complex topics in a concise, professional, and audience-appropriate manner across different formats
  • You demonstrate initiative, energy, a willingness to learn, and a strong team spirit, and you are happy to take on responsibility
  • You possess excellent German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.

solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world. Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact. We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security. Role This role is for a Data Scientist on a close-knit team supporting Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) at RAF Mildenhall, UK. This team is at the center of helping the command empower and leverage its data for more effective analysis and decision making. As a subject matter expert, the Data Scientist will leverage their experience to gather and derive insights from complex data, assist the command with development initiatives, and facilitate digital transformation efforts. The work done in this role has a direct impact on mission readiness as the team's efforts go toward making a more resilient and data-driven organization. Responsibilities A Data Scientist will have skills sets of both data analysts and data engineers. Data scientists are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a data pipeline. In addition, data scientists shall interpret and analyze complex sets of data, as well as plan, execute, and manage ML projects with cloud-native platforms and advanced ML solutions. They understand some of the most challenging processes, technologies, and can leverage a vast array of methodologies in the field, such as data mining, natural language programming, and machine learning. Data scientists must have a combination of skills that includes programming, mathematical modeling, statistics, and domain knowledge. They must combine an advanced math and statistics background with programming, domain knowledge, and communication skills to analyze data, create applied mathematical models, and present results in a form useful to the organization. They must also be able to understand and manipulate structured and unstructured large data sets, which requires proficiency in distributed SQL programming, relational and non-relational data queries, general programming languages (such as Python and R,) and machine learning techniques. The Data Scientist shall perform the following tasks: • Interpret and analyze data using exploratory mathematic and statistical techniques based on the scientific method. • Coordinate research and analytic activities utilizing various data points (unstructured and structured) and employ programming to clean, massage, and organize the data • Experiment against data points, provide information based on experiment results and provide previously undiscovered solutions to command data challenges. • Coordinate with Data Engineers to build Data environments providing data identified by other data professionals • Apply and develop scientific methodology, statistics, and algorithms to discover and frame relevant problems, hypotheses, and opportunities. • Develop predictive and prescriptive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), text mining and processing, clustering, forecasting methods, and other advanced statistical techniques. • Design and automate processes to facilitate the manipulation and analysis of data. Manage and integrate data across dissimilar data sets. Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured data. • Use frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop to conduct large-scale data processing. Perform statistical modeling and create data visualizations using products like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI and R Shiny. • Research, design, and implement algorithms to solve complex problems. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages. • Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake. • Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling. Requirements A minimum of 1 year of hands-on Data Science experience is required. Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field is required. Proficient with one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Python, R, etc.) Demonstrated ability to apply data science to solve real-world problems Secret Clearance Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with DoD Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields. Familiarity with Envision Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility Salary Range: $97,000 - $233,000 Pay Range The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role. Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range. Total Rewards In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions. At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact. Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise Tavily London Tavily Forward Deployed Engineering 37 minutes Tavily Forward Deployed Engineering London 37m The Team Forward Deployed Engineering owns how Tavily shows up technically in the field. The team sits at the intersection of customers, Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success. The Enterprise FDE motion focuses on Tavily’s highest-value customers and strategic enterprise opportunities — from technical discovery and solution design through proof of concept, production rollout, adoption, and expansion. The role This is a full-time, on-site role based in our New York office. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise, you’ll work directly with Tavily’s largest and most strategic customers to design, prototype, and deploy production-grade AI systems powered by Tavily’s API. You’ll own the technical relationship across the customer lifecycle, helping enterprise teams move from early use case exploration to deployed, scalable agentic applications. You’ll be deeply hands-on: building RAG pipelines, agent workflows, evaluation loops, reference architectures, and custom integrations alongside customer teams. You’ll also serve as a critical bridge between the field and our Product and Engineering teams, translating enterprise needs into roadmap signal. Your responsibilities will include: Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their AI use cases, technical architecture, success criteria, and deployment requirements. Lead technical discovery and solution design during pre-sales and expansion conversations. Scope, build, and deliver proofs of concept that demonstrate clear business and technical value. Design and implement production-ready integrations using Tavily’s API, including RAG pipelines, agent workflows, internal tools, and industry-specific GenAI applications. Partner with customer engineering, data, product, and AI teams to move use cases from prototype to production. Monitor customer API usage patterns and recommend improvements to increase reliability, latency, coverage, and overall value. Translate recurring customer needs, blockers, and technical patterns into clear product and roadmap input. Create reusable enterprise assets, including reference architectures, integration templates, deployment guides, demo environments, and technical documentation. Represent Tavily in customer architecture reviews, executive technical conversations, implementation check-ins, and post-deployment reviews. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to drive adoption, retention, and expansion across strategic accounts. We expect you to have: 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Consultant. Strong hands-on engineering ability, especially with Python, APIs, backend systems, and production software development. Experience building with LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, agent architectures, context engineering, and modern AI application stacks. Experience working with enterprise customers, including technical discovery, POCs, solution design, stakeholder management, and production rollout. Strong understanding of how enterprises evaluate, deploy, secure, and scale AI systems. Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive stakeholders, including engineering leaders, product teams, AI teams, and technical decision-makers. High autonomy, strong ownership, and comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical concepts into clear recommendations. Based in New York City, or willing to relocate. It will be an added bonus if you have: Experience working with major agent or LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or CrewAI. Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant, or similar systems. Experience with enterprise AI use cases in financial services, legal, consulting, enterprise SaaS, sales, marketing, or internal knowledge management. Track record helping large customers move from POC to production. Experience building internal tools, technical playbooks, demos, or reusable customer-facing assets. Prior experience at a high-growth AI infrastructure, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS company. About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role:

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.

You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

 

What you'll own:

  • Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.

  • Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.

  • Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

  • The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Compensation Band: £65-80K OTE [60/40]

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

This is a rare opportunity to shape how Sitecore grows through its partner ecosystem across two of its most dynamic regions. The Partner Marketing Manager owns joint marketing with Sitecore's implementation partners across EMEA and Asia Pacific, as well as our international reseller community—turning those relationships into a powerful, scalable route to market.

You will build and run co-marketing programmes that are deliberately aligned to Sitecore's core FY27 buying motions— including our market-leading CMS SitecoreAI, our AI-powered DAM and Scrunch, the best way to win AI search. Every campaign you launch will be tied to a business problem our customers are actively trying to solve, and to the pipeline and bookings that follow.

The role blends ambitious strategic thinking with confident hands-on delivery. You will work shoulder to shoulder with partners, regional sales leaders and the wider marketing organisation to extend Sitecore's reach through and with our ecosystem, and you will see the impact of your work in the pipeline, in partner momentum, and in the customers we win together. You will take on a broad and genuinely influential remit across EMEA, Asia Pacific and our international reseller network:

What You Will Do:

  • Align partner marketing to the FY27 buying motions: Translate Sitecore's buying motions into partner-ready campaigns, narratives and assets, ensuring every parent campaign is correctly aligned and consistently tracked

  • Build joint plans with EMEA and APAC implementation partners: Develop and manage ambitious quarterly marketing plans with our systems integrators and implementation partners, using multi-channel tactics—webinars, events, digital campaigns, executive roundtables—to create demand and pipeline in-region

  • Support our growing international reseller business: Design scalable, repeatable marketing programmes and campaign-in-a-box toolkits that equip resellers across international markets to generate and progress demand independently, with the messaging, enablement and support they need to succeed

  • Drive pipeline and revenue through the channel: Align every partner programme to regional sales objectives, generating new-customer leads, accelerating pipeline and contributing directly to bookings targets for Sitecore's core and new offers

  • Develop and champion partner relationships: Build trusted, energising relationships with key partners and reseller leaders. Work closely with partner account managers to spot joint opportunities, shape go-to-market programmes and keep partners engaged, informed and invested

  • Coordinate across regions and functions: Partner with Field Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Product Marketing, Campaigns and Sales across EMEA and Asia Pacific to adapt global content for partner use, respecting local market nuance while keeping messaging consistent and on-brand

  • Measure, learn and report: Track programme performance against clear KPIs, analyse results across campaigns, regions and channels to determine ROI and best practice, and share regular, insight-rich reporting with internal stakeholders and partners alike

  • Manage budget and Marketing Development Funds: Own the partner marketing budget, including MDF and co-op funds, allocating investment to the partners, markets and motions with the greatest potential for return

  • A minimum of 5 years of B2B marketing experience, including direct experience with partner or channel marketing programmes in the technology or software industry

  • Experience marketing across multiple international markets—EMEA and/or Asia Pacific especially—with genuine sensitivity to cultural and market differences

  • Confidence building campaigns around solution and outcome-led themes rather than product features

  • Demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) skills

  • An analytical and data-driven mindset

  • Marketing technology proficiency: familiarity with modern marketing tools and platforms is required, including CRM software such as Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, web analytics tools, content management systems, and business intelligence dashboards

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to influence senior partner and internal stakeholders

  • Strategic and creative thinking, paired with the drive to deliver hands-on

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working with global or regional DXP systems integrators and implementation partners

  • Experience building reseller or distributor marketing programmes at scale

  • Familiarity with Sitecore or other martech and digital experience products

  • Understanding of AI-led marketing use cases, including AI search visibility and digital asset management

London Product Full Time 52 minutes Product Full Time London 52m Introduction to Role & Team Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business. As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding. You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on. What You’ll Do Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery. Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business. Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results. Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product. Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters. Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version. Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve. Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly. Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards. Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact. Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create. About You You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release. You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens. You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on. You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising. You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict. Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right. You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care. You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version. You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate. You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.
