Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.

  • Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.

  • Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.

  • Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.

  • Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.

  • Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.

  • Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.

  • Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.

  • Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.

  • Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

About You

  • You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.

  • You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.

  • You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.

  • You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.

  • You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.

  • Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.

  • You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.

  • You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.

  • You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.

  • You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.

  • You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.

  • Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

 

✨ Kind, curious, and low-ego designers thrive at Bumble Inc. If you’re excited to shape how people around the world form relationships and find belonging, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. source_record.description:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
 
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
 
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
 
Company video
 
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
 
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.
 

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Management Accountant to join our finance team. This role plays a critical part in delivering accurate financial insights, supporting strategic decision-making, and driving business performance.

As a Senior Management Accountant, you will be responsible for preparing monthly management accounts, performing financial analysis, and partnering with key stakeholders across the business. You will ensure the integrity of financial reporting while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and profitability.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will provide meaningful commentary on financial performance, budgets, and forecasts, helping to guide business strategy. This role also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to the continuous development of the finance function. 

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant looking to take on a high-impact role within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key responsibilities will include

• Preparing the monthly Management Accounts for subsidiaries. We currently have subsidiaries based in the UK, USA, Germany, China, Australia, Poland, India, Spain, Korea, Canada and Japan.
• Carrying out month-end tasks such as revenue recognition, cost of sales workings, accruals, prepayments, and maintenance of the fixed asset register.
• Balance Sheet reconciliations
• Bank reconciliations
• Debtor, creditor, and bank revaluations.
• Intercompany reconciliations
• Analyse the financial results to produce commentary for senior management for both internal and external reporting
• Carrying out project work such as improving files, systems, and processes.
• Responsible for VAT/GST Returns including any other Monthly/Quarterly local tax returns and ensure deadlines are always met
• Work with the local accountants/advisors to ensure the subsidiaries’ account balances are aligned with ours
• Responsible for any other applicable returns in the Subsidiaries as and when required
• Assist with the preparation and filing of the Statutory Accounts in the Subsidiary countries in line with IFRS/local GAAP requirements
• Assist with Year-End duties and annual audit
• Other ad hoc duties as and when required by the Financial Controller and Finance Director.

Essential Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in an accounting environment, with knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP
• Qualified Accountant
• International Experience
• Good Academics
• Month End Experience including Prepayments, Accruals, Revenue Recognition
• Strong analytical skills, with high attention to detail
• Good Excel skills including Vlookups, Pivot tables and Sumifs
• Able to work to strict deadlines
• Able to work independently and take the initiative in solving problems
• Solid understanding of basic accounting payable principles, including a good knowledge of VAT
• Proven ability to calculate, post and manage accounting figures and financial records
• Ability to communicate and work at all levels with a large number of stakeholders i.e. junior staff to senior management.

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience in leading teams and managing junior staff
• Experience using Sage 200, Credit Hound and TM1 – Apliqo
• Experience using Paperless
• Experience using WebExpenses
• Audit experience from a Big 4 or mid-tier firm

Vision RT is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and development without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Orbital's next phase of growth is US-led. New York is where the go-to-market weight is moving, and hiring follows it. We are hiring a Head of Talent to own that and all hiring across the UK and US.

This is a precision function, not a volume one. Every hire is expected to raise the bar. You will be measured on the calibre of who joins, not how many.

Talent at Orbital has been built and run by a specialist embedded partner, and that engagement now hands over to a permanent in-house function. The building blocks are in place and TA is a respected function in the business: Ashby, scorecards, interview design and reporting are all live and operating. Your job is to take that function fully in-house, own it permanently, and take it from good to exceptional.

What you'll own

The strategy. The company-wide hiring plan, built with the CEO, COO and CRO from growth targets. It is your role to define how that plan gets delivered, and you will have full autonomy to do it. From team to tools to operations.

The team. A precision talent team across the US and UK. The current TA team are all experienced recruiters. Your role is to coach and develop them into a genuinely high-impact team, and to hold that standard as it grows.

The method. Orbital hires direct. Your team works search-led: they map a market, build a target list and go after named people rather than working inbound. You set that standard, and you personally run the searches where seniority or business impact demands it.

What we're looking for

A scale-up track record. You have built or materially scaled a talent function inside a VC-backed technology company through a comparable arc, roughly 100 to 300 people.

Precision over volume. Your track record is low-volume, high-calibre hiring. You can point to specific hires that changed a company's trajectory and explain exactly how you found, engaged and closed them.

GTM and Engineering depth. You have personally owned both GTM and Engineering hiring in your career and have knowledge of the UK and US markets.

Executive search craft. You have designed and run targeted headhunt processes end to end for people who were not looking: market mapping, target lists, multi-touch engagement, assessment and close. You can walk us through the process, not just the outcome.

Executive-team fluency. You hold your own on commercial strategy with a CRO, technical org design with a CTO, planning with a COO, and the talent narrative with a CEO. You operate as a peer who brings a position, not a service provider taking a brief.

Operational rigour. Forecasts hold. Pipeline reviews happen. Data in the ATS is accurate without being chased. Follow-up does not slip, and stakeholders always know where a search stands. You are detail-oriented by instinct, because precision is what wins at this level.

US and UK experience. You have run a distributed recruiting team across US and UK time zones with a single operating rhythm, one quality bar and clear accountability in both markets.

A record of raising a team's level. Not just managing one. Clear expectations, honest feedback, visible performance data, real coaching on craft.

AI literacy in practice. You already build AI into how your function works, and you can show what it changed about your team's output.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You measure yourself on requisitions filled, time-to-fill and headcount delivered above all else.

  • You want to manage an agency panel and a vendor budget. We hire direct, and your job is to make agencies unnecessary.

  • You want to step back from the work. You will personally run the hardest searches.

  • You are not comfortable being uncomfortable and dealing with change.

  • Performance conversations are something you avoid or defer.

  • AI is something you talk about rather than something already in your workflow.

If that sounds like your job, apply

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director, Marketing to own the whole marketing function across demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, with accountability for pipeline contribution, the market narrative, and the marketing budget. The team is seven people across the US and UK. You will set direction, connect marketing to the commercial number, and run as one go-to-market unit with our (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

Based in London or New York, with regular travel across the US and Europe.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and lead the full marketing function: demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, including the team across the US and UK and the complete marketing budget.

  • Bring the team together with a clear marketing plan and operating rhythm, and connect the function to the commercial number.

  • Own an agreed and evidenced marketing contribution to pipeline, reported consistently and trusted by sales leadership and the board. Run the function off numbers: pipeline sourced and influenced, conversion by stage, cost per opportunity and programme return.

  • Refresh positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across marketing, sales and product, so the same story is told the same way.

  • Hold and defend the full marketing budget. Make real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, reallocate on evidence, and show what each dollar returned and what was stopped.

  • Lead and coach the team. Retain and stretch top performers, set clear expectations, and shape the team structure around the plan.

  • Build a measurably stronger share of voice in cyber risk analytics across insurance and reinsurance media, analysts, and industry events.

  • Run marketing across US and European markets. Judge where a global message holds and where it has to flex, and manage a team split across time zones without defaulting to one side.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Product, and run as one go-to-market unit with the (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

What We Look For

  • Proven marketing leadership across all three pillars: demand generation, product marketing and communications/events, with a team of comparable size and seniority. Has set the plan, allocated a budget and been held to a pipeline number.

  • Has marketed complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers in a B2B SaaS or analytics business. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs. Understands how marketing creates and accelerates enterprise pipeline rather than reporting on it.

  • International experience. Has run marketing across US and European markets and managed a team split across time zones.

  • Budget ownership. Has held and defended a full marketing budget, made real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, and can evidence return.

  • Metrics-oriented. Runs the function off numbers and is comfortable being inspected on them alongside sales. Knows the funnel numbers without looking them up and coaches the team against them. Stops what is not working quickly and moves the budget to what is.

  • Product marketing judgement. Can shape positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across sales, product and comms.

  • Commercially accountable. Volunteers for the number rather than negotiating away from it, and is as comfortable in a forecast review as in a creative one. Not precious about which activities get prioritised, and agile enough to change them as the company scales.

  • Executive credible. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to carry the CyberCube story.

  • A high accountability people leader who raises the bar on an existing team. Sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, and is respected for it.

  • Strong editorial judgment and taste. Will not ship undifferentiated content, and can tell the difference between a message that resonates with the market and one that only resonates internally.

  • Partners with Sales and Product by choice, not by process. Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.

  • Based in London, with regular international travel across the US and Europe.

 

Strong Plus

  • Has marketed into insurance, reinsurance or financial services. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, the Lloyd's market, banks or asset managers. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.

  • Experience marketing alongside a direct enterprise sales team with named accounts, including account-based marketing into a defined target list.

  • Has built or materially raised a brand in a category that needed defining rather than one that already existed.

  • Has run a flagship industry event presence and an executive speaking programme, and can judge which events are worth the money.

  • Analyst and media relations experience, and comfort with thought leadership built on proprietary data.

  • Has scaled a marketing function through a step change in growth expectations.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. AI-assisted content production, agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

source_record.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


How you'll empower our tech and product leadership

You be a strategic partner and a vital force multiplier for our Chief Product Officer, Tom (CPrO) and incoming Chief Technology Officer (CTO). By anticipating their needs, shaping their organisational engagement, and prioritising their diaries against company objectives, you will help turn their strategic vision into real momentum across the Product & Technology teams.

  • Owning the operating rhythm: You will proactively manage the executives' time and diaries, utilising your knowledge of Product Development Lifecycles and Engineering to effectively balance urgent requests with important strategic priorities.

  • Driving strategic communications: You will draft, shape, and constructively challenge key messaging from the executives, ensuring communications are clear, consistent, and land successfully with various audiences.

  • Preparing with a point of view: You will go beyond basic preparation by synthesising information, highlighting crucial details, and recommending decisions ahead of key meetings and board sessions.

  • Being the ear to the ground: You will stay attuned to team sentiment and blockers across Product & Technology, bringing insights to the executives early and advising on the best response.

  • Fostering an AI-native culture: You will partner with the executives and other Executive Assistants to design impactful cultural moments, such as hackathons and Town Hall meetings, ensuring momentum continues long after the events conclude.

  • Running the Product & Tech engine: You will oversee logistics for the Product & Tech Leadership forum, manage fast-changing schedules, and monitor asynchronous Slack conversations to highlight matters needing executive attention.

  • Delivering impactful projects and events: You will own and run projects on behalf of the executives from planning to delivery, while also managing the logistics for internal and external events, offsites, and team socials.


You should apply if...

  • You are an experienced Executive Assistant: You have previously supported Product, Tech, or Engineering leaders within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proactive forward-thinking is your natural state: You excel at thinking multiple steps ahead, actioning potential next steps before the executives have even considered them.

  • You're a critical prioritisation partner: You are a critical thinker who has the ability to challenge executives on their priorities, messaging, or plans to keep them focused on what matters.

  • You use AI as your teammate: You are confident leveraging AI tools, effective prompting, and automation to redefine how you work and find smarter ways to execute.

  • You're the master of diaries and complex logistics: You have excellent time-management skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a proven track record managing fast-changing schedules and team events under tight deadlines.

  • You have strong industry and business acumen: You understand how product and engineering organisations deliver, enabling you to help leaders balance the urgent with the important.

  • You're an empathetic, high-EQ communicator: You influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, read how change lands across an organisation, and adapt your communication style seamlessly.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

  • £60,000 - £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight.

We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites.

Role Overview

Responsible for the mechanical design of satellite structures, mechanisms, and related hardware from concept through qualification and on-orbit operation.

Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and validate them through prototyping and environmental testing.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical systems and components for satellites, including primary structure, thermal-control hardware, secondary structures, and mechanisms.

  • Generate 3D CAD models, fully dimensioned drawings, and interface control documents using GD&T, managing assembly configuration and PLM data.

  • Take hardware from conceptual design through qualification to on-orbit operations, leading design reviews, and planning verification tests.

  • Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass, and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers.

  • Support prototype builds, assembly, integration, and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems, and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

 

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or related engineering discipline.

  • 5+ years’ experience in satellite mechanical design, including primary structure, pipe routing, electromechanics, and MGSE for aerospace applications (satellites, payloads, launch vehicles).

  • Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks.

  • Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials, structural mechanics, FEA ,and thermal management.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering Space Technology – You'll contribute to launching groundbreaking technology into space. Your work on our revolutionary ion propulsion system and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and disrupt traditional LEO operations.

  • Unmatched Ownership and Impact – You'll experience a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry. You will participate in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and Competitive Salary – You'll receive not just a competitive salary but also company ownership stakes. Your dedication and hard work are rewarded with a share in the technology you help build, ensuring you're a part of our collective success.

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package – Including private health insurance with dental and optical coverage, annual healthcare check-ups etc.

  • Hybrid Work - A hybrid setup with one dedicated remote day per week.

Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Core data modelling: Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

  • Modelling at source: Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

  • Self-serve platform: Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

  • Agents as consumers: Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

  • Metrics that matter: Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

  • Answers, not just queries: Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

  • Standards: Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

 

What we’re looking for

  • You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

  • You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business.

  • Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

  • Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't.

  • Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query.

  • You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on.

  • Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked.

    What We Offer

    • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

    • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

    • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

    • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

    • Gym membership & wellness benefits

    • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

    • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

    • MacBook Pro + team kit

    • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


    Interview process

    We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

    1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

    2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

    3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

    4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

    5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

BA Principal / Lead Primary Engineer - HV Substations Bakerhicks High Voltage - UK 4 hours High Voltage - UK 4h Help Shape the Future of the UK's Energy Infrastructure BakerHicks has established itself as a trusted engineering partner within the UK's Transmission & Distribution sector, delivering major infrastructure projects for some of the country's leading utility clients. With continued growth and a strong pipeline of secured work, we are seeking an experienced Principal/Lead Primary Design Engineer - HV Substations to join our expanding Power team. This is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical energy infrastructure projects, leading technical excellence across complex HV substation designs up to 400kV. The Opportunity: Reporting to the HV Substation Team Leader, you will lead a team of Primary Design Engineers and CAD Technicians, ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality engineering solutions and technical documentation. You will provide technical leadership across HV substation projects, support the development of junior engineers, and act as a key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders. You will also support business development activities by contributing technical input to tender submissions and helping secure future project opportunities. Why This Role: Work on some of the UK's most significant Transmission & Distribution projects. Be part of a business that is helping deliver the infrastructure required for the UK's energy transition. Lead and mentor a growing team of engineers and technicians. Work closely with major utility clients including National Grid, SSEN, Scottish Power, UKPN, ENWL and others. Enjoy genuine opportunities for career progression, technical leadership and professional development. Collaborate within a multidisciplinary engineering environment where innovation and new ideas are actively encouraged. See projects progress through the full lifecycle, from concept and design through to construction and energisation. Key Responsibilities: Technical Leadership Lead the delivery of primary engineering design for HV substation projects up to 400kV. Manage and mentor a team of engineers and CAD technicians. Ensure the quality, accuracy and consistency of project deliverables. Support and develop junior engineers through coaching and technical guidance. Provide technical oversight and approval of engineering work. Take ownership of HV Plant CDAE responsibilities on National Grid projects where applicable. Design & Engineering Prepare, review and approve: Primary layouts and elevations. Single Line Diagrams (SLDs). Transformer sizing and specifications. GIS and AIS switchgear designs. Shunt reactors, NERs and reactive/capacitive compensation schemes. Switchroom layouts. CT sizing calculations. Busbar design and short-circuit force calculations. Busbar and connector specifications. LVAC systems for substations. Earthing studies and earth return current calculations. Insulation coordination studies. Mechanical interlocking schemes. Equipment technical specifications. Type registration documentation. Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities. Project Delivery Manage programme, budget and quality requirements for engineering deliverables. Prepare, review and approve feasibility studies, outline designs, detailed designs and technical reports. Review and approve construction drawings and technical documentation. Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers. Support bid and tender submissions. Maintain updates to the Business Development Tracker. Participate in client meetings, design reviews and technical workshops. About You: You will be an experienced HV Substation Engineer with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions. You will have: Significant experience delivering primary design and engineering for HV substation projects up to 400kV. Strong knowledge of UK Transmission and Distribution standards and specifications. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience leading engineering teams and reviewing technical deliverables. The ability to work independently while supporting and developing others. A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving. Essential Requirements BEng or BSc in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. Extensive experience in HV substation primary design and engineering. Experience producing designs, calculations, reports and drawings associated with substation projects up to 400kV. Strong understanding of IEC standards and industry best practice. Experience working to National Grid and DNO specifications. Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating project delivery. Experience working alongside CAD technicians using AutoCAD, Revit or similar software. Desirable Requirements MEng or MSc in Electrical Engineering. National Grid HV Plant CDAE accreditation. Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or actively working towards chartership. Experience supporting bids, tenders and work-winning activities. Join Us This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong HV Substation Engineer looking to take the next step in their career, working on industry-leading projects while helping shape the future of the UK's energy infrastructure. At BakerHicks, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, influence key engineering decisions, and develop your career within a growing and highly respected engineering consultancy . AL Associate Director, Regulatory Strategy Alnylampharmaceuticals Maidenhead Regulatory Sciences 5 hours Regulatory Sciences Maidenhead 5h The Associate Director of Regulatory Affairs Strategy will serve as an EU Regional Lead for our mid/late-stage CNS programs and may have the opportunity to be the Regulatory Program Lead for early programs in Alnylam pipeline. The will work on assigned programs with the respective Global Regulatory Portfolio Lead, Global Regulatory Lead and cross-functional team to lead the EU regulatory strategy and facilitate submission of data packages to the EMA. The role is responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams. Summary of Key Responsibilities Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline. Work with the Global Regulatory Lead and Regulatory Affairs management to lead and define regulatory strategy and to compile and submit, in a timely manner, regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements and lead EU HA interactions. Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments. Develop detailed regulatory strategy and project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects. Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities. Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines. Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs. Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements. Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance. Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate. Qualifications Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills. Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines. Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process. Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc. MAA filing and Type II variation experience is preferred. Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects. Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants. Technical system skills (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online research) including submission-ready formatting. Clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including: Commitment to People, Fiercely Innovative, Purposeful Urgency, Open Culture, and Passion for Excellence. About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality. Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others. At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content
  • Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings
  • Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities
  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

 

#LI - HYBRID 

#LI - RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

As the Office Assistant for Marqeta's London branch, your role will be pivotal in managing the office's requirements. You will be a proactive professional, trusted and respected for handling sensitive information and crucial relationships.

  • Order supplies and manage office stock within a budget - drinks, snacks, stationary and equipment as needed.

  • Promote events within our office building.

  • Liaise with the building team regarding any issues that might arise.

  • Provide general support to visitors and manage tracking.

  • Address employees queries regarding office management issues (e.g. stationery, hardware, travel arrangements).

  • Provide general office management support and handle various projects as they arise, even unexpectedly.

  • Manage swag orders and distribution.

  • Support the organisation of charity initiatives.

  • Distribute new hire kits and manage stock.

  • Send communications to the team regarding office updates, events, birthdays, training etc.

Who You Are

  • Self-motivation, excellent organisation, strong work ethic and a proactive approach.

  • Flexibility and comfort in a fast-paced, high-intensity, yet informal startup environment.

  • Proven experience as an Office Manager, Front Office Manager or Administrative Assistant.

  • Experience with office management software like MS Office and Google Suite.

  • Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work.

  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organisational and planning skills in a fast-paced environment.

  • A creative mind with an ability to suggest improvements.
