About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role

Exa is expanding to the EU and the UK and we are looking for an ambitious, proactive, and collaborative Field Marketer to partner closely with our regional team and build demand in this critical market. Companies big and small are making critical decisions about how to invest in AI and how their AI agents will retrieve information, and you will play a key role in how they discover Exa. As the first Field Marketer in EMEA, you will shape how buyers experience our brand and interact with our team, through highly strategic, and thoughtfully crafted events.

This is one of those rare, founding team member opportunities: you'll build the regional program from the ground up and inform so much beyond our event strategy; from messaging and overall brand presence at a pivotal time for Exa. This is an incredible fit for someone who sweats the details, lives to create world-class experiences, and obsesses over how to drive pipeline from every touchpoint. You will own the regional program, identify opportunities to build brand awareness and pipeline through a mix of high-hospitality and lead generating events including: executive dinners, networking receptions, hackathons, third-party sponsorships, partner events, and more. You'll partner strategically with Account Executives and SDRs to build an event plan that delivers coverage across your territory and key accounts.

Our bar is high and our north star is to establish Exa as a world-class brand. We’re a team that embraces learnings as opportunities to optimize future events and processes, while remaining focused on our pursuit to drive ever increasing pipeline. If this sounds exciting to you, we'd love to meet you!

This role is based in person in London, with regular travel across the EMEA and the occasional trip to our San Francisco HQ.

What You Will Own

Regional program strategy. Own the plan for your territory, deciding which formats, cities, audiences, and investments will meet our pipeline goals each quarter. Co-build the plan with input from sales and defend it with pipeline rationale. Success is measured by program quality and by pipeline sourced and influenced in the region.

End-to-end execution. Own every event from concept to post-event follow-up: sourcing venues, orchestrating vendors and production, managing invitations and the run of show, overseeing on-site execution, and sweating every detail. Success is measured by the number of qualified attendees and by nailing execution.

Sales partnership and account targeting alignment. Establish and maintain tight sales partnerships, align with sales to get the right personas and accounts to each event and create effective event playbooks that convert to pipeline. Success is measured by meetings generated and by the number of target accounts engaged through your programs.

Pipeline outcomes and follow-through. Own what happens during and after the event: ensuring timely lead handoff and building the follow-up sequence in partnership with SDRs, Lifecycle Marketing, and Marketing Ops. Success is measured by conversion from attendee to qualified opportunity.

Budget and vendors. Own your regional budget, vendor selection and negotiation, and cost per qualified lead. Success is measured by program impact per dollar.

AI-first operations. Use AI to compress operational timelines: invite-list development, personalized outreach at scale, vendor research, run-of-show generation, and post-event summarization. You'll run a serious regional program because the busywork is automated.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company, including ownership of a regional program rather than execution of someone else's.

  • Deeply committed to event craft: You can walk us through a run of show, tell us what you check at 4pm before a 6pm start, and describe the last thing that went wrong at an event and how you fixed it.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline: You have owned a pipeline number and can speak to cost per qualified lead.

  • Evidence of strong sales partnership: You can speak to how you've built strong partnerships with sales counterparts in similar roles, including how you manage reps who push for something you know isn't the right investment.

  • Deep understanding of the EMEA market: You have a finger on the pulse of the cultural nuances, best venues, vendors, and event tactics that will draw an audience of senior technical buyers here.

  • Meticulous event budget and timeline management: You have both budget and vendor negotiation experience.

  • Upholds a growth mindset: You embrace feedback as a lever to fuel growth and see learnings as an opportunity to optimize for next time.

  • Experience using AI to drive efficiencies: You use AI daily to remove operational load, and can show us how.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running events for a technical or developer audience alongside enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the program rather than inherited it.

  • Experience developing booth designs and strategies that drive lead generation.

  • Familiarity with event tech (registration, badge scanning, on-site capture) and how it connects to CRM.

  • Experience crafting executive roundtables or advisory dinners for senior technical leaders.

  • Experience building reports to track event performance.

Benefits

  • Health and wellness: Premium medical coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit tiered by location.

  • Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

  • Life at Exa: Our SF office serves lunch and dinner daily, with snacks, coffee, fresh bread from a local bakery, weekly milk tea, monthly picnics, and parties to celebrate the wins (and each other). You'll visit often.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Product Owner – Trust Services (eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet & Trust Platform) (f/m/d) idnow Rennes Product 3 hours Product Rennes 3h IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany or Rennes, France. IDnow is looking for Product Owner – Trust Services (f/m/d) to own the product direction, backlog and outcomes for a technical product area within IDnow’s Digital Identity and Trust Services portfolio. Working with a dedicated Scrum Team, this role turns customer, operational, regulatory and engineering input into a clear product goal, an ordered backlog and valuable, usable increments that can be released and operated safely. The most critical aspect of this role is serving as the accountable product interface between the Trust Services domain and Engineering: understanding the system boundaries, APIs, integrations, data flows and non-functional requirements well enough to make sound trade-offs, remove ambiguity and ensure that security, privacy, resilience, auditability and regulatory obligations are built into the product from the beginning. Key Responsibilities Own the product goal, roadmap and backlog : prioritize by value, risk, dependencies and learning; keep decisions transparent. Drive Scrum outcomes : lead refinement, support Planning and Reviews, clarify Sprint Goals, and use delivery metrics to improve flow. Turn needs into buildable requirements : define user/system journeys, domain concepts, business rules, APIs, data states, errors, acceptance criteria and testable non-functional requirements – without over-prescribing implementation. Partner on solution quality : work with Engineering, Architecture, Security, QA and Operations on service boundaries, technical debt, scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, incidents and operational readiness. Own data, integration and lifecycle design : govern identity and audit-data flows, access, protection and retention; shape secure, interoperable APIs, including authentication, encryption, versioning, error handling and documentation. Support releases and continuous improvement : define readiness, migrations, cutovers, deprecation, feature flags and rollback; participate in incident reviews and prioritize recurring quality, security and operational issues. Translate regulation into product decisions : apply eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet, QES, QEAA/EAA, identity-proofing and trust-service requirements with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Trust Services SMEs, tracking adoption, reliability, quality, delivery flow and compliance readiness. Collaborate across functions: align with Scrum Team s , Engineering leadership, Architecture, Security, SRE/Operations, Trust Services, Product, Compliance/Legal/Risk/Data Protection, Commercial and Customer Success, as well as relevant partners, relying parties and standards bodies. Preferred Experience 4+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis or similar roles in software and service delivery, including direct responsibility for backlog quality and product outcomes. Hands-on experience working in Scrum or a comparable agile delivery model: ability to define a Product Goal, order a Product Backlog, write clear product backlog items, set acceptance criteria, participate in refinement and reviews, and make timely scope and priority decisions. Strong technical fluency in modern software products and integrations, including REST APIs, JSON/Open API, authentication and authorization, OAuth2/OIDC concepts, webhooks or event streams, data models, service boundaries, API lifecycle and backward-compatible change. Demonstrable experience working with regulated software and services, translating regulatory, security, privacy and audit requirements into actionable product requirements and delivery decisions, while balancing compliance, customer value, usability, scalability and time to market. Practical understanding of secure software and service delivery: threat and risk thinking, software security, access control, encryption, secrets and key management, vulnerability handling, logging/monitoring, incident response, resilience and software supply-chain considerations. Practical understanding of data lifecycle and privacy-by-design for identity and trust services, including data minimization, purpose limitation, sensitive evidence, retention and deletion, evidence, archival, data residency, audit trails and access transparency. Ability to work with Engineering on system-level trade-offs without needing to be the implementing engineer, and to distinguish product decisions, architecture decisions, implementation choices, technical debt and operational risk. Experience with service operations and lifecycle management, including release readiness, SLO or service-quality thinking, incident triage, post-incident learning, customer-impact assessment, migration, deprecation and support enablement. Experience in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, telecom, public sector, payments, KYC/AML, digital identity, electronic signatures, PKI or trust services) is a strong plus, as is familiarity with eIDAS2, EUDI Wallets, ETSI standards or QTSP operating models. Perks & Benefits Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions. We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences. We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours. We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect across teams. May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefits of our parental leave policy or our sabbatical programme. In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations. IDnow applies the principles of non-discrimination and equality: We strive to establish, maintain, and promote an open and inclusive recruitment process and working environment by respecting the principles of equal opportunities. Including but not limited to: race or ethnic origin, religion or convictions, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, disability, age, or sexual orientation. source_record.description:
Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d'une carte de frais professionnels, remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

source_record.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation. Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering , vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers. Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants. Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit. Vos responsabilités Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables. Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue. Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights. Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit. Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables. Compétences et expériences désirées Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil. Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles. Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile. Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés. Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine. Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. Pourquoi rejoindre Capco? Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers. Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution. Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel. Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées. Nos marqueurs distinctifs : Une spécialisation sectorielle forte Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie. Une approche collaborative et sur mesure Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles. L’excellence comme exigence Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée. About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a founding people-leadership role. There is no team to inherit and no legacy to maintain — you build the team as well as the stack, and you are accountable for both from day one. Early on you will be deliberately hands-on, because there is no one else to solve the hardest problems — but hiring your first engineers, coaching them, and setting their growth paths starts immediately, not later. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will be the founding Engineering Team Lead for storage on our cloud.

Block, filesystem, and object storage for training runs, sandboxed workloads, and general compute: you decide what we build, what we buy, and how it adds up to storage our customers can bet a business on. Some layers we deploy and harden from best-in-class vendors. The ones that matter most we write ourselves in Go — S3-compatible object storage, tiering, backup and recovery, caching layers that put cold data on cheap spinning disks.

As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You will own capacity planning across datacenters and the architecture that keeps data durable when disks, networks, and entire sites fail. Storage is a strategic bet for this org: the team you build and the calls you make will define how a gigawatt of European compute stores its data.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the storage stack — block, file, object — for training, sandbox, and general compute workloads.

  • Make the build-vs-buy calls: deploy and harden vendor platforms where they win; design and write our own services in Go where they don't.

  • Own the data plane: allocation, duplication, tiering, backup and recovery, S3-compatible APIs.

  • Plan capacity across datacenters and across failure domains — petabytes, not terabytes.

  • Build the team from zero: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own performance and growth paths, and set the standard for ownership.

  • Partner with Product Managers to shape the storage roadmap and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have built storage systems — object, block, or distributed filesystems — not just operated them. You know what happens when a disk dies mid-write and when a rebalance collides with a backup window.

  • Deep distributed-systems fundamentals: durability, consistency, replication, erasure coding, failure domains.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Systems engineers coming from C++ or Rust who are ready to write Go daily should still talk to us.

  • You are comfortable with hardware reality: HDD, SSD, and NVMe tiers, and the economics of each.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

source_record.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

As the Data Governance Director , you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will be responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. This role ensures strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations. 1. Data Governance & Taxonomy Management Framework & Model Ownership: Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model. Annual Taxonomy Review: Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons. Naming Conventions: Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems. AdTech & Tracking Governance: Oversee tracking standards across server-side tagging, GA4, channel grouping governance, and migration projects (e.g., BBB – ARM Migration). 2. Operations & Compliance Management Data Accuracy Enforcer: Drive global data compliance from current baselines up to a strict 95% accuracy rate across all channels, Maisons, and markets. Input Data Readiness: Ensure clean, trusted input data flows into Optimus dashboards (and ultimately WPP Open), eliminating fragmented taxonomies and reporting discrepancies. Team & Process Oversight: Direct and advise Data Operations Executives and Associate Directors on best practices for automated data validation beyond basic string checking. Qualifications & Profile Experience: 8–10+ years of proven experience in Digital Data Governance, Taxonomy Management, or Media Data Operations. Background: Strong AdOps background with hands-on experience in digital tracking, ad serving, and multi-market data compliance. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of taxonomy architecture, dynamic UTM/naming structures, Accutics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), server-side tracking, and campaign management workflows. Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of enforcing governance standards across multi-brand, multi-agency, and international team environments. Key Soft Skills: Great autonomy, strong organizational skills, and a strategic mindset. High level of diplomacy, active listening, and the ability to communicate technical data governance standards clearly to both executive stakeholders and operational teams. About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration — writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Partner & Ecosystem Management: Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what “earning with Ledger” means for our users.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance — especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.

  • Team & Stakeholder Communication: Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.

What we’re looking for:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration — writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Partner & Ecosystem Management: Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what “earning with Ledger” means for our users.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance — especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.

  • Team & Stakeholder Communication: Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

source_record.description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

Our impact: guaranteeing the right product in the right place at the right time for our stores, warehouses, and marketplaces worldwide. Transformation Projects & SAP: Challenge upcoming product features with the project team, drive updates on our SAP ECC module (SD/MM), and help prepare the S/4HANA migration planned for 2028. Automation Mindset: Passion for eliminating manual repetitive tasks, tracking data performance, and integrating AI into daily operations. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life. Changing the game for good . We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports. source_record.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

As a Business Development Intern, your main priorities center on qualifying and completing the onboarding journey with Asian sellers. After activation, you will grow sellers’ business including working with sellers to maximize product selection and acting as a trustworthy bridge between internal stakeholder teams and sellers to deliver the best e-commerce experience for customers on Back Market.

You will be able to contribute to overall business by leading BD enablement projects that unleash the potential of sellers to scale up.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Qualify and onboard new sellers to contribute to Back Market’s selection growth

  • Manage newly activated sellers through a hybrid approach of dedicated 1:1 account management and pooled coverage, focusing on Sellers GMV & Quality performance to ensure a profitable and healthy growth for both seller and Back Market

  • Partner with internal functional teams (quality, logistics, finance, legal etc) to support new sellers

  • Constantly explore top sellers on competitors' platforms with global supply origin, including Hong Kong/China/Asia, etc.

  • Support on BD seller communication, including 1) be part of the taskforce to lead on seller recruitment or education webinars; 2) developing Chinese/English content library of BD enablement materials

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-months internship

  • English and Mandarin are no-brainers (fully professional capability in English and Mandarin). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • Excellent in time management with great sense of priority and ownership

  • Detail-oriented and active listener

  • Good organization & communication skills

  • You have an analytical and critical thinking mind - strong use of insights for decision making

  • Abilities to work independently with highly self-motivation. Positive learning attitude is must-have

  • Interested in engaging with small to medium-sized businesses and e-commerce, you ideally have a previous experience in a related field

  • Experience in content creation and live broadcasting is a plus

  • Interested in fast-growing start-ups preferred

  • Salesforce, SQL, and/or Tableau experience is a plus, but readiness to learn a must

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement provided by your French school is required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Home assignment

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

  • • Paris-based Internship salary range, depending on study level €1.2K – €1.4K per month

🌟 VO2 GROUP : Leader français indépendant en conseil Tech et Digital

Entre conseil stratégique et réalisation technologique, nous cultivons un esprit "boutique" : de l'excellence, de l'humain et une forte culture de l'innovation.

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants.

🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate
Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès :
✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation
✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨

🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership
Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine)
Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce

🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable"
Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟
45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes
Campagne primée TopCom en 2024

📜 Certifications et Prix
Salesforce Impact Partner 2024
Cybervadis 2025
Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________


 
Objectif du poste 
 
En collaboration avec un Responsable de Practice ou un Engagement Manager, votre objectif est de participer au développement de la marque en mettant à profit vos compétences métiers et fonctionnelles sur les solutions Salesforce pour mener à bien des projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour nos clients. 
 
Les principales missions 
 
- Intervenir dans des dossiers d avant-vente et sur la mise en œuvre de projets répondant aux enjeux de transformation digitale de nos clients 
- Être en charge de la compréhension, de l’analyse et de la définition de la solution 
- Préparer et animer les ateliers avec le client afin de mieux cadrer ses besoins 
- Manager les attentes des clients afin de leur proposer une solution pérenne 
- Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques, mettre en place un blueprint 
- Être responsable de la conception et de la qualité des livrables du projet, designer la plateforme (paramétrer et/ou superviser) et mettre en place les parcours clients 
- Concevoir des applications, modèles de données, maquettes et solution 
- Concevoir le modèle de données de l'outil de gestion de campagne 
- Gérer les interactions (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email studio) 
- Accompagner le client dans l’élaboration de la Roadmap Solution et anticiper sur les prochaines itérations du projet 
- Être force de propositions, soumettre et défendre des recommandations 
- Promouvoir l’activité marketing de VO2 Force auprès des clients afin de développer l’activité 
 
Profil recherché 
De formation BAC+5 (école de commerce/communication/ingénieur), vous justifiez d au moins une expérience réussie et significative dans la mise en place de solutions de marketing automation sur Audience Builder, Automation Studio, Journey Builder ou Content Builder 
 
Vous connaissez les limites de la plateforme et avez idéalement au moins 1 des certifications marketing : Marketing Cloud Admin / Marketing Cloud Consultant / Marketing Cloud Dev. Vous maitrisez les processus autour du marketing et des parcours clients de divers secteurs d’activité. Une appétence technique sur des notions autours de SQL/AMPscript et HTML est un plus. 
 
Votre sens du service client, de l'initiative, une forte capacité à travailler en équipe et une vision globale sur la gestion de projet seront des atouts pour réussir sur ce poste. Vous savez échanger, écouter et challenger les équipes métier et IT. 
 
Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français et êtes à l'aise à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Vous savez exprimer votre point de vue et challenger vos interlocuteurs pour les orienter vers la meilleure solution pour eux. 
 
Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés.

Entre conseil stratégique et réalisation technologique, nous cultivons un esprit "boutique" : de l'excellence, de l'humain et une forte culture de l'innovation.

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants.

🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate
Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès :
✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation
✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨

🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership
Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine)
Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce

🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable"
Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟

Cybervadis 2025
Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________


Objectif du poste : 
 

Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Technique Salesforce pour accompagner nos clients Grands Comptes dans la conception et l’évolution de leurs plateformes Salesforce.

Vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation Salesforce dans des environnements exigeants, notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe & Retail, de l’Hospitality et de la Finance, sur des problématiques de transformation, d’intégration et de modernisation des SI.

Au sein de l’ESN, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition des architectures Salesforce Core, depuis les phases de cadrage et de conception jusqu’à la mise en œuvre, en collaboration avec les architectes, Tech Leads, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs clients.

Vous contribuerez également à l’évolution des architectures vers de nouveaux usages liés à l’IA générative, l’automatisation intelligente et les agents Salesforce.

 

Missions :

 

  • Définir les architectures techniques Salesforce Core adaptées aux enjeux des clients Grands Comptes.
  • Concevoir des solutions robustes, scalables et alignées avec les standards Salesforce.
  • Participer aux phases de cadrage et de conception et challenger les choix techniques.
  • Accompagner les Tech Leads et équipes de développement dans la mise en œuvre.
  • Définir les architectures d’intégration Salesforce / SI : APIs, middleware et systèmes externes.
  • Garantir les enjeux de performance, sécurité, gouvernance et qualité.
  • Contribuer à l’intégration de nouveaux usages liés à l’IA générative et aux agents Salesforce.
  • Réaliser des revues d’architecture et intervenir sur la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes.
Profil : 

Vous disposez d’une expérience significative sur des architectures Salesforce complexes.

Vous maîtrisez l’architecture Salesforce Core, les problématiques de données, sécurité, intégration, performance et gouvernance, ainsi que les principaux mécanismes de développement de la plateforme.

Vous êtes capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec des équipes techniques qu’avec des interlocuteurs clients, de challenger les besoins et de transformer les enjeux métier en solutions techniques pérennes.

Une première expérience sur Agentforce, Claude Force, LLM ou architectures intégrant des services d’IA est fortement appréciée.

Anglais courant.

Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés.

Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation. CONTEXTE Au sein de l'équipe IT AI Transversal dédiée à la banque de financement et d'investissement (CIB), vous rejoindrez un pôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation IA. L'équipe a pour mission d'équiper les collaborateurs des meilleurs outils IA, de piloter leur adoption et de représenter la CIB au sein des instances de gouvernance IA du Groupe. En tant que Program Lead AI for Tech, vous jouerez un rôle pivot d'interlocuteur privilégié auprès des différentes entités du Groupe sur l'ensemble des sujets IA for Tech. Coordonner : Animer la coordination interne en amont et en aval des instances, collecter les contributions des équipes (IT, Métiers, Sécurité, Conformité) et diffuser les décisions. 2. Volet Tech, Déploiement & Innovation : Piloter et suivre : Assurer le suivi opérationnel des chantiers IA for Tech impactant la CIB (déploiement des outils, modèle économique, LLM on-premise , stratégie agentique, sécurité des Skills ). 🌟 VO2 GROUP : Leader français indépendant en conseil Tech et Digital

Entre conseil stratégique et réalisation technologique, nous cultivons un esprit "boutique" : de l'excellence, de l'humain et une forte culture de l'innovation.

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants.

🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate
Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès :
✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation
✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨

🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership
Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine)
Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce

🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable"
Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟
45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes
Campagne primée TopCom en 2024

Salesforce Impact Partner 2024
Cybervadis 2025
Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________


Nos clients dans les secteurs de la banque et de la finance, choisissent désormais l'innovation et la technologie pour se transformer. Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation.
 
 
CONTEXTE

Au sein de l'équipe IT AI Transversal dédiée à la banque de financement et d'investissement (CIB), vous rejoindrez un pôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation IA. L'équipe a pour mission d'équiper les collaborateurs des meilleurs outils IA, de piloter leur adoption et de représenter la CIB au sein des instances de gouvernance IA du Groupe.

En tant que Program Lead AI for Tech, vous jouerez un rôle pivot d'interlocuteur privilégié auprès des différentes entités du Groupe sur l'ensemble des sujets IA for Tech.

 
DESCRIPTIF DE MISSION

Au quotidien, vous piloterez et animerez la mission autour de deux axes majeurs :

1. Volet PMO & Gouvernance Stratégique :

  • Représenter et préparer : Préparer en amont chaque instance IA for Tech (COPIL, RUN, BUILD, Brainstorming, PI Planning), produire les notes de position CIB, identifier les arbitrages à porter et remonter les alertes.

  • Coordonner : Animer la coordination interne en amont et en aval des instances, collecter les contributions des équipes (IT, Métiers, Sécurité, Conformité) et diffuser les décisions.

 

2. Volet Tech, Déploiement & Innovation :

  • Piloter et suivre : Assurer le suivi opérationnel des chantiers IA for Tech impactant la CIB (déploiement des outils, modèle économique, LLM on-premise, stratégie agentique, sécurité des Skills).

  • Participer à la feuille de route : Contribuer directement aux PI Plannings semestriels du Groupe, à la construction de la stratégie agentique CIB et au déploiement souverain des LLMs on-premise.

  • Diffuser la culture Tech & IA : Impulser les nouvelles pratiques (vibe coding, création d'usines AI pour la production de supports/slides, veille continue).

 
Livrable (liste non exhaustive)

  • Notes de position CIB et supports d'arbitrage pour les instances de gouvernance.

  • Synthèses de coordination multi-entités et relevés de décisions.

  • Feuilles de route et dossiers de cadrage sur les chantiers tech (LLM on-premise, stratégie agentique).

  • Matrice de suivi du modèle économique et de la consommation IA.

  • Supports de présentation et livrables à haute valeur ajoutée (usines à slides / AI-generated).

  • Évaluations d'impacts et fiches de conformité/sécurité liées aux usages IA.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Formation d'ingénieur ou solide diplôme supérieur en informatique/tech (une Grande École type INSA ou un Doctorat/PhD est un vrai plus)

  • 9 à 12 ans d'expérience en conseil, gestion de projet IT ou pilotage de programmes tech complexes multi-entités

  • Expérience en banque/CIB appréciée, mais les profils issus d'autres industries avec une vision enrichissante sont les bienvenus

  • Maîtrise de la gouvernance IA/Tech et du suivi du modèle économique / consommation IA

  • Compréhension des enjeux de déploiement de LLM on-premise, de la stratégie agentique et de la sécurité IA en environnement contraint

  • Excellent relationnel, rigueur et diplomatie face à des interlocuteurs de niveau direction

  • Capacité à produire des livrables de cadrage percutants et forte appétence pour les nouvelles méthodes (vibe coding)

  • Anglais courant obligatoire (niveau C1)


    • Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 🚀
  • Environnement dynamique et axé sur l'innovation
  • Formations, certifications et accès à des solutions de formation e-learning
  • Politique de télétravail (2 jours/semaine)
  • Bonus de cooptation de 2 000 à 3 000 €
  • Tickets restaurant
  • Accès à des crèches en partenariat avec Babilou
  • Salle de sport dans les locaux, prise en charge par l'entreprise
    • Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés.

En tant que Développeur Full-Stack Shopify, vous rejoignez VO2 Brand Experience et intervenez pour nos clients, des marques exigeantes du luxe et du retail, que nous accompagnons sur l'ensemble de leur expérience digitale. Sur ce poste, vous êtes du côté applicatif : concevoir des applications sur mesure et des solutions back-end qui répondent, dans un contexte Shopify, à des problèmes que la plateforme ne résout pas nativement.

Vos missions principales :
  • Développement produit et plateforme Shopify : applications embarquées dans l'admin, extensions, automatisations, Admin GraphQL, données personnalisées (metafields, metaobjects, fichiers, marchés, traductions), OAuth, webhooks, quotas et coût des requêtes
  • Thèmes et contenus : synchronisation de templates entre boutiques, sections et contenus Liquid, transfert des traductions entre marchés.

  • Environnement technique : TypeScript, Node.js, React et React Router, Polaris, PostgreSQL et Drizzle, GraphQL, files de jobs, Liquid, déploiement conteneurisé, tests automatisés. 
 
🎯 Compétences et Qualifications
  • 5 ans minimum en développement web full-stack, dont une expérience significative en e-commerce
  • Maîtrise de l'écosystème Shopify : apps embarquées, Admin GraphQL, données personnalisées, thèmes et Liquid, contraintes et limites de la plateforme. Une expérience Shopify Plus est un vrai plus
  • Socle back solide : modélisation et SQL, files de jobs et traitements asynchrones, idempotence, exploitation en production, tests. TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, React

  • Autonomie, goût de la relation directe avec le métier, capacité à arbitrer un périmètre et à dire non avec une alternative, aisance avec les agents de développement IA sur une base de code volumineuse

  • Anglais : lecture technique parfaitement à l'aise, c'est un besoin quotidien (documentation Shopify, code, commentaires, échanges écrits). À l'oral, savoir se faire comprendre et suivre une discussion technique suffit
